decisive_spans.text: hyperostotic lesion of the outer table of the right calvarium
involving the inferior squamosal portion of the right temporal bone

response.rationale: The vignette describes a hyperostotic, densely calcified mass involving the temporal bone, which are key features of an osteoma. While osteoblastoma is also a bone tumor, the description of a 'densely calcified mass' and 'hyperostotic lesion' aligns more strongly with osteoma. Ossifying fibroma is less likely given the dense calcification and hyperostosis. Mastoiditis is contradicted by the absence of intracranial extension or adjacent soft-tissue mass.
